title: Hearty Sweet Dutch Ginger Pudding
description: A sweet and light Dutch dessert featuring ginger paste, cooked in a copper pot with binchotan charcoal for a unique flavor, low sodium friendly
instructions: In a copper pot, combine milk, ginger paste, and sugar, and heat over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and cornstarch
Gradually add the egg mixture to the milk mixture, whisking constantly
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in melted butter and vanilla extract
Let the pudding cool to room temperature
Cover the pudding with plastic wrap, pressing the wrap directly onto the surface
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours
Just before serving, place the binchotan charcoal on a heatproof surface and light it, then place the copper pot over the charcoal to infuse the pudding with a smoky flavor
